description: REQ-Q5 says '14 consecutive 7-day windows' (= 14 calendar days where each day's rolling-7d sum was negative). is_dormant() only checks neg_7day_windows >= 14 — a CUMULATIVE count of negative windows, not CONSECUTIVE. A slot with 14 non-consecutive negative windows scattered across 100 days would be incorrectly flagged dormant. Test only verifies the int >=14 boundary, not consecutiveness. PROP-Q5 acceptance fixture is silent on the consecutive vs cumulative distinction.
